messages:
elena: FYI opened a PR that adds a short 'latency waterfall -> cost sink' example for the console. shows how to jump from a trace span to the cost breakdown panel. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1242
ravi: sneaky useful. does it show both the per-token cost and per-span compute cost?
elena: yes — two mini tables. i used fake numbers for clarity but added a note on how to query live metrics. snippet included for Node + Python to fetch the cost rows.
mika: quick read: the Python snippet has an import glitch (using legacy client name). i'll push a small fix.
elena: thanks, please push it. i also left a one-liner explaining the mapping between span_id and dashboard tile id (so folks migrating old dashboards can find their tiles).
doc-bot: LinkCheckJob #912: anchor '/docs/console#cost-sinks' returned 404. Suggest updating anchor or add redirect.
ravi: that link was in the migration note. i can update the anchor in the docs site config.
mika: CI also flagged the embedded SVG of the waterfall; the render step converts it to PNG and it's huge. suggest cropping or using the inline SVG with a max-width.
elena: i tried inline SVG but some older browsers in our compatibility matrix don't render gradients correctly. let's keep PNG but export at 2x smaller resolution.
ravi: pushed image resize + updated caption to call out click-to-zoom. caption: "Click any span to jump to the associated cost sink; use zoom control for detail."
elena: added a tiny section explaining how tracehook instrumentation populates the span tags used by the dashboard: `span.set_tag("service.svc", svc)` and `span.set_tag("cache.hit", bool)`. also included how to enable sampling for cost-sensitive traces.
mika: pushed the Python import fix and changed `client = LegacyTelemetry()` -> `client = telemetry.Client()` in the snippet. tests pass locally.
doc-bot: DeployJob #446 queued: rendering with viewport 1280x800. Expected time 3m.
ux-team: quick ask: please add alt text for the waterfall images, and include one small callout arrow pointing at the latency bar that maps to the cost sink. we can mock it in the image.
elena: added alt text and a mock arrow overlay. pushed.
ravi: can someone sanity-check the Node example param names? last time `trace_key` vs `traceKey` caused confusion.
mika: checked Node: using `trace_key` consistently now. i also added a tiny note: "If your telemetry uses `svc` instead of `service.name`, update the query filter accordingly."
elena: note to reviewers: cost figures are demonstrative. replace with queries against your project metrics before sharing with customers.
ux-team: looks fine to us visually. one tiny nit: the waterfall legend could be smaller. not blocking.
elena: great — i'll merge once CI finishes and the link anchor update lands. scheduling a quick post-merge smoke test on staging to ensure the embed renders in IE11 fallback (non-blocking). @ravi can you take that?
ravi: will do after merge, expect a 15m run. :white_check_mark:
mika: thanks all. tagging this as docs:console/observability for the changelog once merged.
elena: merging after green. :rocket:
